reason: I already pay for vidIQ or TubeBuddy and only use half of it, so I don't need another tool. Honestly my videos do better when I post consistently, not when I buy another dashboard.
objection: Tools don't grow channels. Mitra reads the same analytics YouTube already gives me, so I'm not sure it tells me anything I couldn't work out myself.
would_change_my_mind: If I connected my channel on the free 10 credits and it correctly showed me a specific video that beat my usual views and explained why in Hindi or Hinglish, in a way I could check myself.
